linkHealth.title: Status & relations
linkHealth.guideNoMenuEntry: In the message platform menu editor, add an open-workflow entry that selects this workflow, save, and publish.
linkHealth.guideChannelUnreachable: If the network is restricted, configure a proxy in the Network tab of settings
linkHealth.guideChannelTokenInvalid: Replace the token in the message platform edit dialog
linkHealth.guideChannelCheckFailed: Check the error, or configure a proxy and retry
linkHealth.guideTopicNoReadyNode: Make sure this task queue has a subscribing compute node that is online; enable the node in the compute node list, or check node heartbeat and the Comfy service.
linkHealth.guideNoCaseRoutes: Add a routing rule in this workflow's processing flow that points a condition to this task queue, save, then re-check.
linkHealth.guideNoEdgeSubscribers: In the compute node's Deploy dialog, check this task queue, copy the deploy command, and rerun it; create a compute node first if none are available.
linkHealth.guideSubscribersOffline: Check that the proxy on subscribing compute nodes is running, the control plane is reachable, and the Comfy service is healthy.
linkHealth.guideNoTopicBinding: In the node's Deploy dialog, check at least one task queue, copy the deploy command, and rerun it.
linkHealth.guideNoCaseReachable: Configure routing rules in this workflow's processing flow so tasks are dispatched to this node through subscribed task queues.
linkHealth.guideEdgeNotReady: First confirm the compute node is enabled; if it is still offline, check the proxy process, network, and Comfy service, then wait for node heartbeat to recover.
linkHealth.guideCaseMissing: This workflow no longer exists — recreate it in the workflow list or select another entity.
linkHealth.guideEdgeMissing: This node no longer exists — recreate it in the node list or select another entity.

linkHealth.noTopicBinding: This compute node subscribes to no task queues
linkHealth.noCaseReachable: No workflow routes tasks to this node
